reviewer: Separate review agent within the same implementation task
independence_boundary: Not an external third-party audit, blanket security clearance, complete upstream conformance result, or independent oracle for all product semantics. The reviewer implemented relation adapters elsewhere in this task; host/UI review controls were separately authored against other agents code.

verification.meaning: Fresh combined run after all reviewed host/UI/server fixes. Native runtime is real except explicit isolated child-process malformed-output injection controls, with a complete paired positive.

checked_boundaries: Raw request and bundle text cross the UI/API boundary as strings without browser JSON normalization; strict duplicate-key/exponent rejection occurs in the verifier.
Malformed transport envelope is HTTP400 error JSON; malformed product documents are HTTP200 structured REJECTED_MALFORMED reports.
Package loading alone does not display VERIFIED; input edits, file loading, control changes, network errors and stale async verification responses invalidate the report and download.
The wrong-commit demo uses a known synthetic request and is disabled after manual input; it does not parse or repair untrusted raw text.
Successful replay of native REFUTED remains overall CONTRADICTED with the native negative visible.
Commit/path membership, signature trust, semantic compatibility, guarantee preservation and recomputation remain distinct layer obligations.

Structured rejection reports were freshly validated against report.schema.json after duplicate-key raw request/bundle documents, exponent tokens, malformed required_layers, and oversized/wide semantic assumptions.
Delayed-body concurrent POSTs were checked against the two-verifier execution gate.

Current generic RVR output guards reject missing canonical output, wrong canonical digest/profile identity, false evaluationPerformed, semantic inconsistency, nonzero exits and malformed stdout; a complete injected output remains a positive control.

findings.detail: Prior green report could survive edited inputs or failed subsequent verification; invalidation and revision guards now pass independent UI controls.
Wrong-commit button previously JSON.parse-normalized manual input; now loads known V02 request only in the permitted demo control state.

Missing assumption strings/lists can produce HTTP200 report documents exceeding schema reason-code length/count and explanation limits. Confirmed one2000-char premise,300 unique premises, and32 ~110-char premise names.
findings.expected: Every structured verification response should validate against report.schema.json, including negative and malformed inputs.
findings.resolution: Semantic list/name input bounds and report explanation bound were aligned. All three independently authored long/wide diagnostic cases now produce report-schema-valid negative responses.

findings.detail: Three requests with partial bodies sent before completion all pass the initial active counter test and return200; two-verifier limit is not rechecked before active++.
findings.expected: At least one of three simultaneous delayed-body verification attempts is refused with429 before a third verifier executes.
findings.resolution: The active verifier limit is rechecked immediately before admission to execution. Three delayed-body attempts now include the required429 busy response.

remaining_limitations: UI testing by this reviewer evaluates actual app source in a minimal DOM harness, not a rendered browser. Any separate parent-agent manual browser check is outside this review evidence; layout, visual quality, accessibility and cross-browser behavior were not assessed here.
Tests are finite synthetic controls and targeted source inspection, not fuzzing, penetration testing or a complete cryptographic audit.

The local HTTP service was tested on ephemeral loopback ports; no remote deployment, live provider authentication, chain anchoring, official repository provenance or global history completeness was established.
Original public-spec relation adapters and bounded caller premises do not claim upstream native runtime conformance or external oracle independence.
write_boundary: Only new repository test/report paths were written in this review; no upstream repository, private commercial material, remote write or commit.

runtime.platform: Windows; loopback HTTP on ephemeral ports
